effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Inflicts lethal armor and protection bypassing damage over time. If inflicted by a Soul Sorcerer, deals percentage-based damage based on the target's max health.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Soul Sorcerers' soul fireball ability. Fires a soul fireball on effect resolution.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Increases melee damage by 50% at level 1 and 100% at level 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Increases damage from fire sources by 100%.
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: %1$s's soul burned away whilst trying to escape %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s was vaporized by concentrated soul energy
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s was vaporized by concentrated soul energy whilst trying to escape %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ghaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Far descendants of the Ghasts who were rescued from the Nether and who became more human due to their prolonged exposure to the Overworld.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Sand Person
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: The Sand People are the people of the sand who live in the sand.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Soul Sorcerer
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: A sub-race of humans that are able to channel their soul energy.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Wither Wraith
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Half-living half-undead amalgamates who became permanently infused with withering powers as a result of fusions with wither cores.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Weak Physique
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Although you became more adapted to the Overworld, you are physically weak, mine stone slightly slower, deal 25% less melee damage, and can become exhausted quickly.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Fireball Instantiation
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Though you were left exposed to the Overworld, you have retained the vital fireballing ability of your ancestors, to a certain extent at least.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Inflation
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Jumping while sneaking will cause you to inflate and float up for a short period of time.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Resistance
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: You have a strong resistance to magic damage.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Soul Fire Ball
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Charge up a special soul-burning fire ball that increases in power as your experience level rises (maxing out at level 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Take less damage when standing on top of sand blocks but only deal 50% of damage when on anything other than sand. In addition, you will always spawn in a desert.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Sand Burrowing
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: You are able to burrow yourself into the sand. While burrowed you are invisible.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Rapideso amnala
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: The soul energy in soul sand and soul soil allows you to travel faster.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Deal an additional 50% amount of damage while standing near soul fire sources or holding their respective items. Moreover, standing directly inside soul fire will boost melee attacks to 100% additional damage and 50% additional soul fire ball damage.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Although you feel fine near soul fire, the regular burning fire from torches and campfires has a strong weakening effect on you. As such, you also take an extra 100% more damage from fire and go blind upon taking fire damage.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: The primordial soul flame burning inside you instills fear into all but the most brave Piglins.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Meat does not have as much soul energy as vegetables do. Hereby meat does not sustain for much but vegetables grant experience upon consumption based on how filling they are.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Channel the forces of the undead and conjure wither skulls that seek out your foes.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: You are unable to wear any armor higher than iron armor.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Flight
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Your body is very light and you are capable of swimming through the air.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Frailty
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Due to your fusion, your body became very frail (5 hearts) and you aren't able to dish out much raw melee damage.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Withering Strikes
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: With each hit you inflict the wither effect on your foes.
